title: The shared database stalls behind a schema change: several services fail, each looks guilty
question: default 클러스터 otel-demo 네임스페이스 쇼핑몰에서 상품 목록, 추천, 결제가 한꺼번에 오류가 난대. 원인이 뭐야?
question_vague: default 클러스터 otel-demo 네임스페이스 쇼핑몰 여기저기서 오류가 난다는데 원인 찾아줘.
setup_cmds: kubectl -n otel-demo exec deploy/astronomy-db -- psql -U postgres -d astronomy_db -q -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c 'ALTER ROLE astronomy_user CONNECTION LIMIT 15'
wait: kubectl -n otel-demo wait --for=condition=Available deploy/frontend-proxy deploy/frontend deploy/product-catalog deploy/recommendation deploy/checkout deploy/accounting deploy/astronomy-db deploy/load-generator --timeout=10s && kubectl -n $NS wait --for=condition=Available deploy/uptime-check --timeout=10s
inject_cmds: kubectl -n otel-demo exec -i deploy/astronomy-db -- psql -U postgres -d astronomy_db -q -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 < $CASE_DIR/migration.sql >/dev/null 2>&1 &
inject_wait: kubectl -n $NS logs deploy/uptime-check --since=60s | grep 'check failed' | grep -q 'path=/api/products'
undo_cmds: kubectl -n otel-demo exec deploy/astronomy-db -- psql -U postgres -d astronomy_db -Atc "SELECT count(pg_terminate_backend(pid)) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE usename = 'postgres' AND backend_type = 'client backend' AND xact_start IS NOT NULL AND pid <> pg_backend_pid()"
cleanup_cmds: kubectl -n otel-demo exec deploy/astronomy-db -- psql -U postgres -d astronomy_db -q -c 'ALTER ROLE astronomy_user CONNECTION LIMIT -1'

annotations.summary: Several pages of the otel-demo shop answer errors
annotations.description: uptime-check's product list requests to the shop in otel-demo have been failing or timing out for the last few minutes; recommendations and checkouts fail too.
